action_items: INFO — All V6.25.13 acceptance criteria PASS. No blocking issues. Main agent can ship.

MINOR/OPTIONAL — POST /api/campaigns/{cid}/discover-publish without auth returns HTTP 403 (FastAPI Depends(get_current_user) default). The spec says 401; both reject the request, but if main agent wants strict 401 for unauthenticated vs 403 for unauthorized, get_current_user can raise 401 when no token is present. Test currently accepts 401 OR 403 to avoid flakiness.
critical_code_review_comments: public_discover.py is clean: 224 lines, async/await correct, _id excluded via projection, slug regex sane, unique-slug loop is bounded by candidate-collision check (terminates).

_unique_slug never has an upper bound on n — for a hypothetical campaign name colliding 1000+ times this loops indefinitely. Practical risk is near-zero but adding `if n > 999: raise HTTPException(409, 'slug exhausted')` would be defensive.
GET /api/public/discover/{slug} fetches edges with limit=400 then filters in Python — fine for current scale but a future-proof variant would `$in` the visible_ids in the Mongo query.
DiscoverShowcase.jsx & DiscoverBrowse.jsx both define API const at module scope and use axios — consistent with other landing components.
PublicTables.jsx hides itself when 0 items — good UX call, avoids depressing zero-state on Landing.
Showcase Pill component is local helper, fine for single-file use.

Spec said routes 'showcase-tab-world / showcase-tab-marketplace / showcase-tab-canon' — testids match exactly. Empty states use shared `showcase-empty` testid which is fine since only one tab is mounted at a time.

Slug uniqueness exclusion uses `discover_published: True` — if a previously-published-then-unpublished campaign held a slug, a new campaign could grab the same slug. This is intentional (frees up slugs) but worth documenting for the Canon Registry team.
